summary: On-demand audit backfill export + replayable playback for short-lived SIEM connector (encrypted stream checksums)
description:
Issue summary: Customer (FirstVault Bank) needs an on-demand backfill of tenant-scoped audit events for a 6-hour window covering a suspected misrouting event, plus a replayable playback bundle that their SIEM team can ingest into a short-lived connector. They require per-event integrity checks (HMAC or checksums) and an encrypted manifest proving continuity.

Requested deliverables:
- A backfill export (parquet or gzipped-json) for tenant 'fv-main' covering 2026-03-10T02:00Z through 2026-03-10T08:00Z.
- A replayable playback package with resume tokens and event checksums for verification by their SOC team.
- An encrypted manifest (KMS-wrapped) that lists per-file checksums and sequence ranges.
- One-off live handoff via an ephemeral SIEM connector endpoint (they want a short-lived token and instructions to pull).

Acceptance criteria:
1) File format and schema documented and sample delivered.
2) Each event has a per-record SHA256 checksum and the archive has a manifest with HMAC verification.
3) Export is encrypted at rest and delivered to the customer's S3 bucket with presigned transfer or via a short-lived connector.
4) Support provides a 90-minute window to assist customer during initial ingest and a playbook for resume and verification steps.
impact: Customer SOC cannot complete their incident triage and compliance evidence submission until they receive a verified playback bundle. Affected: production tenant 'fv-main'. Regulatory deadline in 7 days for internal audit. Potential business impact: delayed remediation and audit escalation.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Customer reports they observed incomplete events in their SIEM for tenant 'fv-main' during 2026-03-10 02:00-08:00 UTC.
2) Support attempted standard ondemand export flow; backend returned partial batches and a timeout on the S3 presign job.
3) Customer requests integrity proofs and a playback token for their ephemeral connector to re-ingest events without changing production routing.

2026-03-13 08:15 - Miguel Torres (SRE): Partial export completed for 02:00-05:00 window; encountering a presign failure for larger 05:00-08:00 batches. Escalating to storage team.
investigation_notes: Observed repeated timeouts in s3 presign for objects > 120MB. Hypothesis: transient IAM throttling when generating presigned URLs for archival exporter. Correlation id: cid-7b8f.
Ran internal backfill CLI: infra/tools/audit-backfill --tenant fv-main --start 2026-03-10T02:00Z --end 2026-03-10T08:00Z --format parquet --checksum sha256 --output /tmp/fv-backfill-20260310

Found gap pattern aligned with autoscaling event on exporter pod group (node spin-up between 05:12-05:22 UTC). See Grafana dashboard: https://grafana.internal.redwood/boards/EXPORTER?panel=presign_latency

Checked KMS rotation policy: master key alias 'alias/export-manifests-prod' active and KeyPolicy allows SRE service account. Need to generate HMAC using our ephemeral HMAC service: https://internal.redwood/hmac-service/docs
resolution_notes: Workaround delivered: split large time range into 1-hour chunks and presign small files to avoid presign timeout. Produced 6 compressed parquet files with per-record SHA256 and a manifest containing per-file HMAC (HKDF-derived) signed with KMS-wrapped key.

Delivered bundle to customer S3 (bucket: s3://firstvault-evidence-uploads/replay-2026-03-10/) with a one-time presigned pull link valid 72 hours. Shared extractor script and verify.sh to validate checksums and resume tokens.

Escalation/fix: storage team applied a patch to the presign generator to increase upstream retry and added rate-limiting metrics. Filed internal task INT-90734 to add presign fallback for large objects.

Follow-ups: create a short runbook for 'ephemeral SIEM connector handoff' and add a template to the On-demand Playbooks confluence page. Schedule a 90-minute joint session with FirstVault on 2026-03-15 14:00 UTC to validate ingest.
resolution: Workaround delivered and playback bundle handed off. Storage presign retry improvements underway. Customer accepted temporary delivery; follow-up session scheduled. Pending: close after post-ingest verification by SOC.
